newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-Serla in talks on Biber paper.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla in talks on Biber paper.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said in a statement on Thursday it was in talks with Swiss paper products group Biber Holding AG about buying Biber's fine paper business.
"Metsa-Serla is negotiating with Swiss Biber Holding AG about buying the company's fine paper business," it said.
"The negotiations have not yet been brought to an end. Metsa-Serla will issue information about the matter if the negotiations lead to an agreement between the parties," Metsa-Serla said.
Metsa-Serla head of information Heikki Jarvinen told Reuters by telephone he thought it was highly likely that the company would hold a news conference next week. He did not elaborate.
In the statement, Metsa-Serla also rejected a report in a Swiss business weekly on Thursday which said Metsa-Serla was in talks to buy Biber's fine paper and newsprint businesses.
"The ongoing negotiations are only, contrary to the paper's information, about Biber's fine paper business," it said.
